candidate.title: Migration skips importing legacy embeddable hosts by using cmdtuples on a SELECT, then deletes the only copy of the config
reports: migration never imports existing embeddablehosts because cmdtuples is 0 for select statements, then deletes the legacy setting
db/migrate/20150818190757createembeddablehosts.rb:19 — cmdtuples is the affected-row count for dml; ntuples is the correct row count for a select result

migration's host-import guard embeddablehosts.cmdtuples > 0 can never pass for a select (cmdtuples only reports rows affected by insert/update/delete), making the import block dead code and causing the subsequent delete from sitesettings to silently destroy all configured embeddable hosts on upgrade

p0: existing embeddable hosts are silently destroyed on upgrade — embeddablehosts.cmdtuples > 0 is never true for a select (should use ntuples), so the import block is dead code; even if it ran, the raw sql insert bypasses beforevalidation normalization so stored hosts would never match recordforhost's comparison; line 31 then unconditionally deletes the embeddablehosts/embedcategory settings rows, the only copy of the configuration (db/migrate/20150818190757createembeddablehosts.rb:19, 25, 31)
